# HELLO LED (헬로 LED)

> HELLO LED is a free Android and iPhone app by Yodam (요담) that turns a smartphone screen into a full-screen LED scrolling banner, digital sign, clock, countdown timer, and dot-matrix photo display for concert cheers, airport pickups, shop signs, and birthday greetings.

## Key Facts (핵심 정보)

- **App Name**: HELLO LED (헬로 LED)
- **Developer / Publisher**: 요담 (Yodam), https://yodams.com/
- **Platform**: Android (smartphones and tablets) and iPhone
- **Package ID**: `com.yodam.helloled`
- **Current Version**: 1.0.4
- **Price**: Free (0 KRW / 0 USD)
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yodam.helloled
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816627023
- **Official Website**: https://helloled.yodams.com/
- **Support Email**: helloled@yodams.com
- **Supported Languages (6)**: 한국어 (`ko`), English (`en`), 日本語 (`ja`), 中文 (`zh-Hans`), Español (`es-ES`), Español Latinoamérica (`es-419`)
- **Account Required**: None (no sign-up, no server account)
- **Data & Privacy**: Messages, colors, fonts, favorites, and settings are stored locally on the device. Gallery photos converted to LED dot patterns are processed 100% on-device and are never uploaded to any server.
- **Website analytics**: The official site uses Google Analytics 4 to count visits, language, store-button clicks, and whether the on-page preview was used. Text typed into the preview is not sent. Ads personalization signals are off.
- **Advertising Policy**: The full-screen LED board display never shows banner ads. A banner ad may appear on the editor screen, and an interstitial ad may appear before opening the full-screen board.

## Core Features (주요 기능)

1. **Custom LED Text & Effects**: Choose neon colors (pink, red, yellow, green, blue, cyan, white), adjust text size, brightness, scroll speed, and scroll direction, apply neon glow, flicker, or sparkle effects, and pick from 11 commercial-safe bundled fonts (Pretendard, NeoDunggeunmo, Galmuri, DoHyeon, Jua, Black Han Sans, LaundryGothic, BagelFatOne, NamuJeongwon, JejuMyeongjo, NanumPen).
2. **Full-Screen Landscape & Portrait LED Board**: Rotate the phone horizontally or vertically to fill the entire screen with a high-contrast LED matrix readable from the back of a concert hall or across a shop counter. Automatic screen wake-lock keeps the display from turning off.
3. **Clock, D-Day Countdown, and Timer**: Show the current time, a D-Day countdown, or a timer in large LED dots instead of text.
4. **On-Device Photo-to-Dot Conversion**: Convert any photo from the device gallery into a retro LED dot-matrix graphic on the device without uploading to a server.
5. **Preset Phrases & 8-Slot Playlist**: Built-in phrases across 8 categories (Cheer/응원, Birthday/생일, Airport Pickup/공항픽업, Shop/매장광고, Love/사랑고백, Exam/시험응원, Welcome/환영, Thanks/감사). Save favorite messages and play up to 8 slots in sequence.
6. **Local Wi-Fi Sync & Home Widget**: Sync LED messages across devices on the same local Wi-Fi network without internet servers, and pin messages to the Android home screen widget.

## 한 줄 정의

HELLO LED는 휴대폰을 LED 전광판으로 바꿉니다. 무료입니다. 응원, 세일, 환영 문구를 공식 페이지에서 먼저 본 뒤, 휴대폰을 가로로 눕혀 띄웁니다. 전광판을 켠 화면에는 배너 광고가 나오지 않습니다. 사진과 문구는 서버로 올리지 않습니다.

## Common Use Cases (쓰는 장면)

- **Concert & Fan Cheering (콘서트·공연 응원)**: Hold up bright neon cheering slogans in dark concert venues without banner ads blocking the screen.
- **Airport Pickup & Welcome Signs (공항 픽업·환영)**: Display guest names in large scrolling letters at arrival gates.
- **Shop & Counter Notices (매장·카운터 안내)**: Show `OPEN`, sale promotions, or pickup numbers across a counter or window.
- **Birthdays, Parties & Silent Communication (생일 축하·소음 환경 대화)**: Celebrate events or communicate clearly in noisy environments.

## 자주 묻는 질문

페이지에 보이는 문장과 같습니다.

- 문구를 여러 개 저장하거나 화면이 꺼지지 않게 할 수 있나요?
  자주 쓰는 문구를 즐겨찾기에 저장하고, 최대 8개까지 순서대로 재생합니다. 전광판이 켜져 있는 동안 화면은 자동으로 꺼지지 않습니다.
- HELLO LED는 어떤 기기에서 쓰나요?
  Android 스마트폰, 태블릿과 iPhone에서 씁니다. Google Play 또는 App Store에서 설치합니다.
- 지금 어디서 받나요?
  Google Play와 App Store에서 무료로 받습니다. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yodam.helloled https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816627023
- 전광판 화면에도 광고가 나오나요?
  전광판을 켠 화면에는 배너 광고가 나오지 않습니다. 문구를 고치는 화면에 배너가 나올 수 있고, 전광판으로 들어가기 전에 전체 화면 광고가 나올 수 있습니다.
- 사진이나 문구가 서버로 올라가나요?
  올라가지 않습니다. 사진은 기기 안에서 도트로 바꾸고, 문구와 설정은 기기에 남습니다.
- 다른 휴대폰과 문구를 맞추려면 어떻게 하나요?
  같은 Wi-Fi의 HELLO LED와 문구를 맞춥니다. 서버는 쓰지 않습니다.
